blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.
blocks.zh: 多光谱卫星图像的光谱超分辨率可以使高时空分辨率的超光谱卫星图像能够以低廉的成本进行,大大提高了超光谱遥感的应用性. 这项任务本来就没有把握,因此很适合采用深层次的学习方法。 在本研究中,光谱超分辨率任务被设定为操作员学习问题,SSRON被提议为深操作员网络,有效学习从下取样光谱到连续光谱的函数对函数映射. 该模型被训练为超解的Sentinel-2A类多光谱图像到EMIT图像. 与基线模型相比,SSRON在所有指标上都取得了优异的性能. 该模型还通过预测训练期间未见的波段来展示零射光谱超分辨率能力. 此外,其连续输出配制表明,有可能比本土传感器更细波长间隔地估计光谱。 这些结果表明SSRON的潜力,并将操作员的学习确定为光谱超分辨率的有希望的方向.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Hyperspectral satellite images (HSIs) have become important tools in earth observation. By capturing hundreds of spectral bands, they provide detailed spectral information that is unavailable in conventional satellite imagery. As a result, HSIs have been widely used in applications such as weather forecasting [ 23 ] , precision agriculture [ 22 ] , and water quality monitoring [ 4 ] . However, their broader use is limited by low spatio-temporal resolution and high data acquisition costs [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 超光谱卫星图像已成为地球观测的重要工具。 通过捕捉数百个光谱带,它们提供了常规卫星图像中无法获得的详细光谱信息。 因此,HSI被广泛应用于天气预报[23],精密农业[22],水质监测[4]等应用. 然而,其使用范围较广,受到时空分辨率低和数据获取成本高的限制[12].

blocks.en: To address these limitations, three main approaches have been developed. Spatial Super Resolution seeks to directly enhance the spatial resolution of an HSI; HSI sharpening fuses HSIs with high-resolution multispectral satellite images (MSIs) to improve spatial detail; Spectral Super Resolution (SSR) seeks to enhance the spectral resolution of an MSI to obtain an HSI. HSI sharpening suffers from the lack of high-spatial-resolution HSI reference data, and Spatial Super Resolution cannot overcome the low temporal resolution of HSI or the high cost of HSI acquisition [ 27 ] . Consequently, SSR provides a more practical and flexible alternative.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,制定了三个主要办法。 空间超分辨率寻求直接增强空间高分辨率的空间分辨率; 空间超分辨率通过高分辨率多光谱卫星图像(MSI)使空间高分辨率的引信更加清晰; 光谱超分辨率寻求增强空间高分辨率的光谱分辨率,以获得空间高分辨率。 高空间分辨率HSI的锐化因缺乏高空间分辨率HSI参考数据而受到影响,空间超分辨率无法克服HSI的低时间分辨率或高成本获取HSI[27]. 因此,安保部门改革提供了一个更加实际和灵活的替代办法。

blocks.en: However, SSR is an ill-posed inverse problem in which hundreds of HSI bands are recovered from only a limited number of MSI bands. Traditional SSR is based on shallow encoding methods such as dictionary-based methods [ 2 , 11 , 6 ] . With the emergence of deep learning methods, research has increasingly shifted toward their use. Specifically, variations of convolutional neural networks, generative adversarial networks, and transformer-based architectures have shown strong performance [ 14 , 19 , 31 , 5 , 7 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,安保部门改革是一个反向问题,在这个问题中,仅从为数有限的安保部门改革中恢复了数百个安保部门改革频段。 传统的SSR基于浅编码方法,如基于词典的方法[2,11,6]. 随着深入学习方法的出现,研究逐渐转向使用. 具体地说,进化神经网络、基因对抗网络和变压器结构的变异表现出了强大的性能[14、19、31、5、7、24]。

blocks.en: Neural operators have emerged as a deep learning framework that learns mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces [ 17 , 15 ] . This enables continuous function evaluation, which makes it particularly well-suited for super-resolution. Indeed, various neural operator architectures have shown promise in spatial [ 26 , 10 ] and temporal [ 29 ] super-resolution tasks, but their application to SSR remains limited. While prior work, such as Zhang et al. [ 30 ] , has explored the integration of neural operator architectures for SSR, the direct application of neural operators for SSR remains largely unexplored, with no prior work explicitly formulating the problem as an operator learning problem.
blocks.zh: 神经操作器作为一个深入的学习框架出现,在无限维函数空间之间学习绘图[17,15]. 这使得能够持续进行功能评价,使其特别适合超解析. 事实上,各种神经操作架构在空间[26,10]和时间[29]超分辨率任务中表现出了希望,但它们在安全部门改革中的应用仍然有限。 在前期工作期间,如张等. [30],探索了SSR神经操作器架构的整合,SSR神经操作器的直接应用基本上仍未被探索,之前没有工作明确将问题表述为操作器学习问题.

blocks.en: In this paper, SSR is cast as an operator learning problem and addressed using a neural operator framework. The key contributions are as follows. • The SSR problem is formulated as an operator learning problem, laying the mathematical groundwork for applying neural operators to SSR. • Spatial-Spectral Residual deep Operator Network (SSRON) is proposed, which applies the Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) architecture to SSR while using a spatial–spectral residual CNN as the branch network–adapting architectural principles proven effective in SSR to the operator learning framework. While CNNs have been used in the branch networks of DeepONets [ 18 , 9 ] , this paper, to the best of the author’s knowledge, is the first to adapt a spatial–spectral residual CNN architecture to the operator-learning framework for spectral super-resolution. • The strength of SSRON in SSR is demonstrated, achieving improved performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. The application of this architecture to zero-shot SSR for unseen bands during training and its potential to leverage infinite-dimensional mappings is also demonstrated.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,SSR被设定为操作员学习问题,并使用神经操作员框架加以解决. 主要贡献如下。 安全部门改革问题是一个操作员学习问题,为将神经操作员应用于安全部门改革奠定了数学基础。 · 提议采用空间-分层残余深层操作员网络(SSRON),将深层操作员网络(DeepONet)架构应用于空间-光谱残余CNN作为分支网络,使空间-光谱残余的建筑原则适应操作员学习框架。 虽然CNN在DeepONets[18,9]的分支网络中已经使用过,但据作者所知,本文是第一个根据光谱超分辨率操作员-学习框架调整空间-光谱剩余CNN架构的论文。 所显示的安全部门改革的实力,比最先进的方法提高了业绩。 培训期间将这一架构应用于零镜头SSR,并有可能利用无限维度绘图。

blocks.en: The SSR problem is formulated as an operator learning problem, laying the mathematical groundwork for applying neural operators to SSR.
blocks.zh: 安全部门改革问题是一个操作员学习问题,为将神经操作员应用于安全部门改革奠定了数学基础。

blocks.en: Spatial-Spectral Residual deep Operator Network (SSRON) is proposed, which applies the Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) architecture to SSR while using a spatial–spectral residual CNN as the branch network–adapting architectural principles proven effective in SSR to the operator learning framework. While CNNs have been used in the branch networks of DeepONets [ 18 , 9 ] , this paper, to the best of the author’s knowledge, is the first to adapt a spatial–spectral residual CNN architecture to the operator-learning framework for spectral super-resolution.
blocks.zh: 建议采用空间-分层残余深层操作器网络(SSRON),将深层操作器网络(DeepONet)架构应用于SSR,同时使用空间-光谱残余CNN作为分支网络,使SSR中证明有效的建筑原理适应操作器学习框架。 虽然CNN在DeepONets[18,9]的分支网络中被使用,但根据作者所知,本文是第一个根据光谱超分辨率操作员-学习框架调整空间-光谱剩余CNN架构的论文。

blocks.en: The strength of SSRON in SSR is demonstrated, achieving improved performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. The application of this architecture to zero-shot SSR for unseen bands during training and its potential to leverage infinite-dimensional mappings is also demonstrated.
blocks.zh: 所显示的安全部门改革的实力,比最先进的方法提高了业绩。 培训期间将这一架构应用于零镜头SSR,并有可能利用无限维度绘图。

blocks.en: III Methodologies
blocks.zh: 三. 方法

blocks.en: III-A Architecture
blocks.zh: 三-A 结构

blocks.en: The proposed architecture is based on the DeepONet [ 17 ] , which creates a branch network that encodes the input function at discrete sensor points and a trunk network that encodes locations where the output is evaluated. The overall architecture is outlined in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 拟议架构基于DeepONet[17],它创建了一个分支网络,在离散传感器点编码输入功能,以及一个干线网络,将输出评价地点编码. 图1概述了总体结构。

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Proposed architecture of SSRON. The framework consists of a branch network and trunk network, as shown in (a). The branch network encodes the MSI into a latent representation, and the trunk network encodes the spatial-spectral query positions. (b) shows the specific architecture of the branch network.
blocks.zh: 图1:SSRON的拟议结构。 如(a)所示,框架由一个分支网络和中继网络组成。 分支网络将MSI编码为潜在代表,干线网络将空间光谱查询位置编码. (b) 显示分支网络的具体结构。

blocks.en: The standard multi-layer perceptron branch network is replaced with a spatial–spectral residual CNN, motivated by the strong performance of such architectures in remote sensing SSR [ 31 , 21 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 标准的多层感知分支网络被空间-光谱剩余CNN所取代,其动机是这类架构在遥感遥感系统方面的强性能[31, 21, 3].

blocks.en:
The embedding layer in Figure 1 a maps each coordinate value to a vector according to the following: Embedding : c ↦ [ c sin ⁡ ( f 0 ⋅ c ) cos ⁡ ( f 0 ⋅ c ) sin ⁡ ( f j ⋅ c ) cos ⁡ ( f j ⋅ c ) ] \text{Embedding}:c\mapsto\begin{bmatrix}c\\
\sin(f_{0}\cdot c)\\
\cos(f_{0}\cdot c)\\
\vdots\\
\sin(f_{j}\cdot c)\\
\cos(f_{j}\cdot c)\end{bmatrix} where f i = 2 i f_{i}=2^{i} . The coordinates ( x , y , λ ) (x,y,\lambda) are each embedded independently, and the resulting vectors are concatenated. The trunk network is a simple two-layer fully-connected neural network with 256 hidden dimensions.
III-B Dataset
blocks.zh: 三-B 数据集

blocks.en: The EMIT Imaging Spectrometer’s L1B at sensor calibrated radiance [ 8 ] was used as the HSI source. EMIT is an advanced imaging spectrometer instrument on the International Space Station that outputs 285 discrete bands from the visible to the short-infrared. Bands 74-79, 100-107, 131-143, and 191-217 were dropped due to absorption via water vapor and ozone, leaving a total of 229 bands. 10 scenes were randomly selected from December 2024 with zero cloud coverage, downloaded from NASA’s Earthdata Search. Details of the selected scenes are presented in Table I .
blocks.zh: EMIT成像光谱仪在感光校准光度上的L1B[8]被用作HSI源. EMIT是国际空间站上的一个高级成像光谱仪仪器,其输出285个离散波段,从可见波段到短红外线段. 74-79、100-107、131-143和191-217的乐队因通过水蒸汽和臭氧吸收而放弃,总共留下229个乐队。 从2024年12月起随机选择了10个场景,零云覆盖,下载自NASA的地球数据搜索. 选定的场景详情见表一。

blocks.en: Spatio-temporally aligned MSIs are generated by downsampling the HSI using the spectral response function of the Sentinel 2A satellite [ 1 ] . The initial SRF was downsampled to the 229 bands and normalized, following the approach shown in [ 14 ] . Band 9 was dropped because it samples corrupted bands in the HSI. The downsampled SRF is shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 利用Sentinel 2A卫星的光谱响应功能对HSI进行下采样,生成Spatio-temporary complex MSI [1]. 最初的战略成果框架被降低到229个频段,并按照[14]中所示的方法实现正常化。 乐队9被丢弃,因为它在HSI中样本腐蚀了乐队. 下取样的战略成果框架见图2。

blocks.en: III-C Training
blocks.zh: 三-C 培训

blocks.en: Non-overlapping 16x16 patches were selected from each scene, resulting in a total of 61,600 patches. An 8:1:1 train-validation-test split was used. The models were trained with an Adam optimizer at a learning rate of 5e-5, with cosine annealing and early stopping with patience of 5 epochs for 300 epochs, using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) as the loss function. All training was conducted on a single RTX 5060 Ti GPU.
blocks.zh: 从每个场景中选择了非重叠的16x16补丁,共产生61,600补丁. 采用8:1:1列车验证-测试分拆. 这些模型以5e-5的学习率对亚当优化器进行了培训,其中余弦反射和早期停止了对300个纪元的5个纪元的耐心,并以平均绝对错误(MAE)作为损失函数. 所有培训都是以单个RTX 5060 Ti GPU进行.

blocks.en: III-C 1 Training SSRON
blocks.zh: 培训

blocks.en: Unlike conventional image-to-image models, the SSRON is trained to predict the value of the learned function at a specified spatial and spectral coordinates. To enable this, 2048 possible positions (spatial and spectral) were selected in the HSI label to be predicted by the SSRON for each epoch.
blocks.zh: 与传统的图像到图像模型不同,SSRON在指定的空间和光谱坐标上接受过预测所学函数值的培训. 为此,在HSI标签中选择了2048个可能的位置(空间和光谱),由SSRON为每个时代预测.

blocks.en: III-C 2 Zero-shot super resolution
blocks.zh: III-C 2 零射超分辨率

blocks.en: As neural operators learn maps between infinite-dimensional function spaces, they can be evaluated at previously unseen coordinates. To test this capacity, a fixed percentage of bands was intentionally excluded from training, and the model’s performance was evaluated across all bands. The excluded bands were selected to be relatively equidistant and to span the same wavelength range as the data.
blocks.zh: 随着神经操作员在无限维函数空间之间学习地图,可以在之前未见的坐标上对其进行评价. 为了检验这种能力,有固定比例的乐队被故意排除在培训之外,并且对所有乐队的成绩进行了评价。 被选中的被排除在外的波段相对相当远,并跨越与数据相同的波长范围。

blocks.en: III-D Baselines
blocks.zh: 三-D 基线

blocks.en: AWAN, Restormer, and SSRAN architectures were selected as state-of-the-art baselines because they have demonstrated strong performance for SSR tasks [ 31 , 28 , 13 ] . The U-shaped Neural Operator (UNO) [ 20 ] and the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) [ 15 ] were included as comparable baselines for operator learning. The RSNO proposed by Zhang et al. [ 30 ] was not included as a baseline because it relies on additional physics-based information as input to the model, which was neither available nor assumed in this experimental setting.
blocks.zh: AWAN、重聚器和SSRAN架构被选为最先进的基线,因为它们在SSR任务方面表现出了强大的性能[31、28、13]。 U形神经操作员(UNO)[20]和Fourier神经操作员(FNO)[15]被列为操作员学习的可比基线. 张等提出的RSNO. [30] 没有被列为基线,因为它依赖更多的基于物理的信息作为模型的输入,而在这个实验环境中既无这种信息,也没有这种信息。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: Table II reports the results evaluated over the testing dataset. SSRON outperforms all baseline models across all tested metrics. UNO also performs strongly, outperforming all non-operator baseline models. In contrast, the FNO shows substantially higher errors, which may be attributed to the sharpness in spectra that needs to be reconstructed; standard FNOs struggle with such high-dimensional features [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 表二报告测试数据集评价的结果。 SSRON的绩效超过了所有测试度量衡的所有基线模型. 联合国组织还大力执行所有非操作人员基线模型,其业绩超过所有模型。 相比之下,FNO显示的误差要大得多,这可能归因于需要重建的光谱的尖锐性;标准FNO与这样的高维特征发生斗争[16].

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows the per-band errors of each model. SSRON achieves a lower error across all bands, with the exception of band 115, where the UNO shows a lower error. A sharp increase in error is observed in the bands below 5 and above 200. This behavior is likely due to the limited spectral information of the Sentinel-2A satellite in those regions, as shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 图3显示每个模型的每段差错。 SSRON在所有波段实现较低的错误,但波段115除外,其中UNO显示较低的错误. 5以下和200以上的波段误差急剧增加。 如图2所示,这种行为很可能是由于哨兵-2A卫星在这些区域的光谱信息有限。

blocks.en: The relationship between SRF coverage and the errors is further supported by Pearson’s correlation test. The correlation between the MAE ( ↓ \downarrow ), RMSE( ↓ \downarrow ), and PSNR( ↑ \uparrow ) with the SRF value at each wavelength is -0.222, -0.175, and 0.408 (p < < 0.01), respectively, demonstrating a clear inverse relationship between error and SRF values.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, SSRON remains competitive with the state-of-the-art performance at 90% of bands used and attains a lower MAE than other methods. Because SSRON takes wavelengths as a continuous input, the model can in-principle be evaluated between the native sensor bands. The zero-shot results suggest the potential for such spectral interpolation, although validation against denser spectral measurements would be needed to confirm the accuracy of HSI beyond the native discretization.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,SSRON仍然以90%的频段的先进性能具有竞争力,并取得比其他方法更低的MAE. 由于SSRON将波长作为连续输入,该模型可以在原生感波段之间进行原则评价. 零射线结果表明,这种光谱插值具有潜力,虽然需要对照更密集的光谱测量进行验证,以确认超出原生光谱化的HSI的准确性。

blocks.en: V Conclusion and future directions
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和未来方向

blocks.en: This work presents SSRON, a deep operator network that uses spatial-spectral convolutions with residual connections as its branch network. Empirically, the SSRON achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on simple SSR and demonstrates its potential for zero-shot prediction of additional bands.
blocks.zh: 这项工作介绍了SSRON,这是一个深层操作网络,使用空间-光谱演化法,将剩余连接作为其分支网络。 经验是,SSRON在简单的SSR上实现了最先进的精度,并展示了其对额外波段进行零射线预测的潜力.

blocks.en: The paper offers a novel perspective on the SSR task and opens a new direction for applications of operator learning. Future work should focus on optimizing neural operator architectures to further improve model performance. In addition, the continuous spectral representation enabled by this framework motivates further study of the densely sampled spectral interpolation for downstream applications, such as materials classification of imaged regions. Finally, varying the input SRF to support the general application of SSRON to various satellites is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 该文件为安全部门改革任务提供了新的视角,并为操作员学习的应用开辟了新的方向。 今后的工作应侧重于优化神经操作架构,进一步提高模型性能. 此外,这一框架所促成的连续光谱表示,促使人们进一步研究下游应用的高采样光谱插值,如图像区域的材料分类。 最后,为支持SSRON在各种卫星上的一般应用而改变战略成果框架的投入是今后工作的一个重要方向。
